caveats: UNNAMED. This is agricultural parcel data, not a gazetteer. It was previously published here mislabelled as place names, which was wrong; it now has its own entry and the place-name layer comes from OSM.
Rendered as anchor points only. The parcel boundaries are not carried, so this is a density/hint layer, not a cadastral layer.
Occupation and usage codes are live land management, so they change without notice.
